name: mauxi
description: A local-first Linux workspace for polishing real web interfaces.

scripts.build:host: esbuild src/infrastructure/electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:esbuild --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --outfile=dist-electron/main.js && esbuild src/infrastructure/electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs && esbuild src/infrastructure/preview/bridge.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/bridge-entry.js
scripts.dev: npm run build:host && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 44173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:44173 && cross-env MAUXI_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:44173 electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.fixtures:dev: concurrently -k -s first "npm run dev -w @mauxi-fixture/vite" "npm run dev -w @mauxi-fixture/next"
scripts.fixtures:build: npm run build -w @mauxi-fixture/vite && npm run build -w @mauxi-fixture/next
scripts.verify:production: npm run fixtures:build && tsx scripts/verify-production.ts && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.test:browser-e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:lifecycle-e2e: npm run build:host && playwright test --config playwright.lifecycle.config.ts
scripts.test:setup-e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.setup.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
